evidence.note: InResponseTo echoes a different, stale request ID, likely from another browser tab or an earlier attempt. All other checks passed: status, issuer, destination, signature, audience, recipient, time window, NameID and attributes.

output.fix: Make the SP store the AuthnRequest ID per browser session (cookie or server-side session) and compare it with InResponseTo when the response arrives. Don't let parallel login attempts overwrite each other's stored ID. Have the user restart login from a single tab. If IdP-initiated SSO is intended, enable it explicitly on the SP instead of relaxing the check. Keep signature validation and the other checks enabled.
